items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Replaced by Gordon Beck and Ron Mathewson replaced Tex. But we always had Daniel on drums.

ctx.x: Later, uh replaced by Gordon beck,

Replaced by Gordon Beck and Ron Mathewson replaced Tex. But we always had Daniel on drums. Man, you know, from playing jingles and all that stuff all of a sudden I’m playing every major festival in Europe, you know, because of Jean Louis’ influence and Simone booking us. I man, right off the bat we started recording for Pathé the French label, did a thing called “Alive and Well,” it was received very well and man I was off and running man five years of you know headlining and stuff, so that was … I’ve always been…
I heard you say in an interview one time when you went to Europe you felt like you were let out of a cage.
